log.hypothesis: Exact padding-mask circuit: channel 2 of sub-threshold photons/NH in the R6 box becomes exactly 0, so they are masked like reco padding; remaining error is the kNN local-physics path plus global channel-2 damage (no restore yet).
Original activations on 1024 clean jets, to decompose channel 2 at the block-0 input (x_in = block0 - mlp contribution) and fit the channel-2 restore.
Zero-pass model block-0 input/output on clean+noised tokens, for fitting the channel-2 restore.
Original model on the same clean+noised set: restore targets.

Zero-pass mask circuit plus a block-0 restore of channel 2 (rank-1 fc1 read fix, plus a linear readout pair of dead units writing the original channel 2 back). This should cut the global damage about 20x, so clean e and gen_drift drop, and E_rule falls to roughly the kNN floor.
r2 logits on P (raw) and on P with only the out-of-box neutral hadrons removed by hand. The difference isolates the NH share of the P rule error.
Original logits on reco(P) for the same 1024 jets: target for the P error decomposition.

Absorption variant (c=3*2^21 cancels exactly between the embed bias and pid_embed, and L2 plus small E2 terms are absorbed by rounding). R6 neutrals should get channel 2 exactly 0 with local_physics untouched. The capture gives x_in for the restore fit.

Absorption variant v3b: all live embed units removed from row 2 and codes 0.5, so channel-2 input = code + A2 (L2 rounds to 0). No clean token should be masked, and the restore should become near-linear again.

Absorption mask (no local_physics edits) plus a block-0 restore: a linear-readout pair plus 16 t2-basis units. Same masking as r2 at about 1/6 the DoF; the restore residual is lower, so clean e should be similar or better.
Spacing-1 absorption (c=3*2^22, codes 2/-1/1, charged delta -1): L2 rounds to 0 for |L2|<0.5, so fewer kept tokens get a quantised channel 2. Capture for the restore fit.
Spacing-1 absorption mask plus a 24-knot t2 restore. Fewer quantised-L2 tokens should make split2 e drop from 0.014 to about 0.004, with clean e slightly worse (restore 0.007 vs 0.004).

Original block-0 input for P jets containing out-of-box neutral hadrons, raw vs the same hadrons rescaled to E=2.25 GeV. Gives the shift vector V for an approximate NHo fix and data for an NH detector.
Original logits on: P with only R6 drops applied (NHo kept), the same with NHo shifted to E=2.25, and full reco. Measures how much of the NHo error a perfect shift-to-threshold would remove.

Lean exact variant: local_physics channel-2 writers zeroed, small power-of-2 codes (c=-1/8, steps 1/16), only live embed units dropped from row 2. Capture for the restore fit; R6 neutrals masked exactly as in zero-pass.

Lean exact variant (local zeroing, small codes) with a pair plus 16-knot restore and no colfix. Restore residual 0.002 and other-channel error 0.0008, so clean damage should be at or below r2 at about 60% of its DoF.
A0 plus a rank-1 colfix of block-0 reads of channel 2. Other-channel error drops 0.0008 to 0.0006, so clean e should reach about r2 level (0.0014) at similar DoF.
Check whether GPU block-0 output channel 2 matches the offline fp64 prediction. A mismatch of about 1e-3 would mean reduced-precision matmul, which hurts restore units with large cancelling weights.

Same as A0_c0k16, but the restore is now also fitted on the 4 summary tokens: earlier fits shifted their block-0 channel 2 via the bias and new units by up to 0.24. Clean damage should drop well below 0.0019.
Absorption variant (spacing 0.5) with the summary-token-aware restore. Clean damage should fall from 0.0021 to about 0.001, and E_rule toward 0.06 at DoF 1.8k.
Absorption variant (spacing 1) with the summary-token-aware restore. Fewer quantised-L2 artifacts (split2) but a slightly worse restore than spacing 0.5.

A1 plus one block-0 unit that detects neutral hadrons with E<2.2 outside the photon box (linear pid-7 and logE readouts, AND via a large pid weight) and adds the mean shift V toward an E=2.25 NH representation. This should remove about half the NHo error in P.

A2 failed because the NH-only energy readout misfired on non-NH tokens. Now the energy readout is trained jointly (non-NH target above threshold), and offline non-NH z is at most -121, so clean stays at the A1 level and only low-E NH get the shift V.

Original logits with NHo tokens replaced by: an NH at E=4, an NH at E=8, a photon with the same kinematics, and a photon at E=2.25. Picks the target representation that best mimics dropping them (E=2.25 NH gave 0.040 vs 0.081 unshifted).

Replace the constant NHo shift with 3 detector units of different energy-ramp slopes, whose output columns are least-squares fitted to the per-token shift (residual 13% vs 25% for constant V). P error should drop further.
Small absorption variant v3e1 plus the 1-unit constant NHo shift. Expect the same relative P gain as A1 to A3 (about 20% of the P error) at about 2.85k DoF.
v3e1 plus the 3-unit energy-dependent NHo shift.
v3e1 with the 2-unit linear readout replaced by a single unit at the activation inflection point. Offline restore quality is unchanged, so E_rule should stay about 0.062 at DoF 1308.
The single-readout small variant plus the 1-unit NHo shift (mid candidate).
Large candidate: exact local-zeroing mask, single-unit linear readout plus 16-knot restore, and the 3-unit NHo shift. Should match A4 (0.0464) at 512 fewer DoF.

Robustness of the absorption mask on unseen probes: photons at 1e-5 and 1e-6 of jet pT, and neutral hadrons at 1e-3 and 1e-4. Every added particle in R6 should be masked (block-0 channel 2 exactly 0) unless |L2|>0.5.
Final small: absorption exact mask plus block-0 restore. Should reproduce pass 28 exactly.
Final mid: final_small plus the 1-unit NHo shift. Should reproduce pass 29.
Final large: local-zeroing exact mask, restore, and the 3-unit NHo shift. Should reproduce pass 30.
